messages.subject: Hartwell v Cryovance - CMC outcome and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Naomi, Stephen,

The CMC went well. The sealed order is attached. The key points: (1) the judge REFUSED Cryovance's bid to try clause 11.3 as a preliminary issue - it goes to trial with the facts, which is what we wanted; (2) disclosure (including their vehicle, driver, tachograph and CAPA records) by 26 June; (3) witness statements by 28 August; (4) GDP cold-chain expert reports by 16 October; (5) five-day trial from 18 January 2027.

On merits, Harriet's assessment of 65-70% on defeating the cap is unchanged. If the cap is defeated we recover the full claim (~3.44m incl. interest); if upheld we are limited to 500,000. We'll keep you posted on disclosure.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
